content:
Then, in turn, answered him Agamemnon, king of men:  
"I rejoice to hear your words, O son of Laertes, for you have set all forth in order and made clear. These terms I willingly swear to, my heart impels me, and I shall not break the oath by the god. But let Ajax himself remain there, though eager for battle as Ares; and do all of you others also remain steadfastly until the gifts come from the ships and we cut the faithful oaths. To you personally, I command and charge this: Choose among the best counsellors of the Achaeans to carry the gifts from beside my ship which we yesterday promised to give to Achilles, and to lead the women. And let Talthybius swiftly go through the wide host of the Achaeans to prepare a boar for sacrifice to Zeus and to Helios."
